title: Envelope
description: CloudEvents 1.0 envelope in the structured JSON mode, with the organisation and site extensions. The id is the message's UUID and its idempotency key, published as Nats-Msg-Id. The type names the data schema, which is the file named after the type.

source.description: URI reference of the producer, such as /sss/analytics

type.description: Versioned event type, such as sss.analytics.event.v1

subject.description: What the event is about within the producer, such as the surveillance event's id

organisation.description: Extension: public id of the organisation, absent for platform messages

site.description: Extension: public id of the site, absent for organisation-wide messages

data.description: The payload, valid against the schema of its type
